  {"step":1,"file":"fuzzing/json_minify.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":14,"var":"maybe_smaller","code":"[[maybe_unused]] auto maybe_smaller = glz::minify_json(buffer);","note":"The fuzzer feeds attacker-controlled bytes into the JSON minifier, which parses the input while copying it to a new buffer."},
  {"step":2,"file":"include/glaze/json/minify.hpp","function":"detail::minify_json","line":16,"var":"it","code":"switch (json_types[uint8_t(*it)]) {","note":"The minifier classifies each input byte and dispatches on JSON token type while advancing through the buffer."},
  {"step":3,"file":"include/glaze/json/minify.hpp","function":"detail::minify_json","line":58,"var":"value","code":"const auto value = read_json_string<Opts>(it, end);","note":"String tokens are decoded from the attacker-controlled input and written to the output buffer."},
  {"step":4,"file":"include/glaze/json/minify.hpp","function":"detail::minify_json","line":94,"var":"value","code":"const auto value = read_json_number<Opts.null_terminated>(it, end);","note":"Number tokens are parsed directly from the input stream, so malformed numeric forms can drive parser edge cases."},
  {"step":5,"file":"include/glaze/json/minify.hpp","function":"detail::minify_json","line":151,"var":"out","code":"out.resize(ix);","note":"The output buffer is resized to the number of bytes written; any over-advancement of the write index would surface as a container overflow during the copy path."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]\n')
print(p.read_text())
